expected_response.note: Incumbent preserved; no operative parameter change.

failure_modes: Any edit here would be justified only by coordinate-observable contrasts that the executing pointcloud scalar does not contain, so it could displace surrounding coordinates without a demonstrated affinity benefit.
Treating pair-kernel or shape contrasts as physical interaction energies or causal affinity gradients would misread diagnostic descriptors as the objective.
Using non-monotone observed-node linear trends with extrapolation disallowed to justify a temporal teacher or regional-attention change would exceed the observed support.
Interpreting survival enrichment or turnover residual rates as decoded terminal affinity would conflate joint-head credit and reclassification with the primary objective.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's own findings establish that no supplied evidence measures final predicted target affinity (decoded terminal learning labels unavailable; recorded affinities removed), so the primary objective cannot be adjudicated by any registered edit. The strongest coordinate contrasts (pair kernels 1.5-5.0 A positive, 7.0 A negative; negative shape_xx/yy/zz/yz) are label-bound favorable-minus-comparison endpoint descriptors, and the observable definitions and formula registry state the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, or geometry-block term; therefore no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) is connected to those contrasts by the executing formula. Continuous trends are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed, polynomial fits rejected, and sign changes/strong conflicts, so they do not support a time-conditioned teacher or regional-attention change. Curve support selection excludes the candidate curves on fidelity criteria. Survival effects are joint-head credit, turnover residuals mix reclassification and extant-parent weighting, and branch-adjusted covariance and joint diagnostics are observational, not affinity predictors. With no defensible expected advantage over the incumbent and no affinity outcome evidence, retaining the incumbent is the correct affinity-first choice; no temperature, resampling, affinity-head derivative, extra forward, graph-equality, or atomic-type control is proposed.
